subject: Business Models
title: AI-Powered Subscriptions
description: A quick, practical guide to AI-Powered Subscriptions.

hook.text: ChatGPT Plus costs $20/month. GitHub Copilot costs $10/month. AI is the subscription economy's new growth engine.

buildup.text: AI tools deliver clear productivity gains, making the subscription easy to justify with measurable ROI.

discovery.text: Unlike entertainment subs, AI tools get more useful over time as models improve. Retention is inherent.

twist.text: AI companies burn enormous capital on compute. OpenAI spends billions per year on servers alone.

climax.text: AI subscriptions may become the dominant new category, but only if companies reach profitability before funding dries.

punchline.text: $20/month for a tireless assistant. AI subscriptions sell productivity.

quiz.question: What makes AI subscriptions different from entertainment subscriptions?
options: They improve over time and deliver measurable productivity
